SILT#00024: GitHub pre-releases can't be accessed with the `latest` tag, which makes sense now as they are not meant for proper releases. Also, when updating a Gist, the raw file link changes, so you can't hard code the link. Overall, the simplest way to have an updater file is in the repo itself
